messages:
maya: Heads-up — eu-west canary failed during post-upgrade smoke. Error looks like creds mismatch after secrets rotation.
kevin: dump? logs?
maya: paste from canary pod: `gcp-kms: decrypt error: key not found`
jen: that was the secrets rotation we ran at 03:00. Did the chart bump include new secret name?
kevin: chart change bumped `values.secrets.serviceKey` -> `serviceKeyV2` in 6c4b9d. We didn't update the preflight job.
tom: ahhh. Preflight job reads `values.secrets.serviceKey` — if absent it creates stub -> downstream fails when runtime expects KMS-backed key.
maya: deploy-bot marked canary unhealthy and paused promotion: @deploy-bot status?
deploy-bot: Canary 3098765432-eu-west paused due to podCrashLoop backoff. Action: hold and notify release-ops.
release-ops: we need a decision: roll back chart or pin values in deploy pipeline for eu-west only? Window is open for 30m.
jen: pin values for eu-west to pre-bump SHA + manually re-run preflight after secret name swap. Rolling back chart could unblock but loses the other fixes.
kevin: agree pin + hotfix preflight. I can push a values override to the deploybot queue: `helm upgrade --set-file secrets.serviceKey=@/secrets/legacy.key -f override-eu.yaml`
tom: make sure we annotate the release with `release-note: pinned-for-secret-rotation` so downstream ops know it's temporary.
maya: ok kev, do that and tag me. I'll run smoke tests as soon as deploy-bot finishes.
kevin: queued: `deploy-bot promote --env eu-west --overrides override-eu.yaml --annotate "pinned-secret-rotation"`
deploy-bot: Queued job 3098765450 by kevin. ETA ~2m. Post-actions: run preflight, then canary cut.
jen: also update release notes draft: add a bullet under "Known Issues" about the secret-name change and temporary pin per-region.
kevin: added note in /docs/release-drafts/3098.md and pinged @release-ops for approval.
release-ops: approved the note and the pin approach. If smoke passes, we'll unpin and cut the global promotion at 04:15.
maya: smoke passed. Canary looks healthy after override. :thumbsup:
kevin: will schedule unpin job after 15m and coordinate with secrets team to ensure KMS alias exists.
tom: leaving annotation `pinned-secret-rotation` and `temp-unpin-ETA=3098766375` on the release.
release-ops: recording decision: pin-eu-west + manual-preflight -> success -> unpin scheduled. No rollback.
maya: thanks everyone. Follow-up: create a checklist to validate secret-name changes in chart PRs (preflight check item).
jen: noted — will add to the helm PR template.
